name: DOHMH and DEP Waterborne Disease Risk Assessment Program Annual Report Data: Percentage of interviewed cryptosporidiosis case-patients reporting selected potential risk exposures before disease onset, by Immune Status
description:
This dataset contains annual data from the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) and Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) Waterborne Disease Risk Assessment Program. It reports the percentage of interviewed cryptosporidiosis case-patients who reported selected potential risk exposures before the onset of illness, broken down by immune status. The 28 rows correspond to reporting years, and the nine columns include the year plus exposure percentages for two groups: persons with HIV/AIDS and immunocompetent persons. Several columns appear to represent different exposure categories or high-risk subgroups within each immune-status group, though the column names are abbreviated and do not fully spell out which exposures they measure.

The data could be used to track trends over time in reported risk exposures among cryptosporidiosis patients, compare exposure patterns between immunocompromised and immunocompetent individuals, and support public health surveillance, risk communication, or waterborne disease prevention planning.
